13.t: Working with data: flame tests and precipitates
q: Identify the positive ion in X and in Y.
Name the compound in solution W, with reasons.
Sodium chloride: sodium from the flame, chloride from the white precipitate with silver nitrate.
Z gives a blue precipitate and no silver nitrate result. Suggest what Z is and one more test to confirm.
A copper(II) compound, but not a chloride, bromide or iodide; e.g. copper sulfate. Test with barium chloride: a white precipitate shows sulfate.
